descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S17 「现成的 spec（模型是 mock 的）：Save & Extract 正好关掉提取器返回的那些任务，提议的任务重新加载后还存着，任务提取失败时保留记录并给出重试提示」 Existing specs (mocked model): Save & Extract closes exactly what the extractor returns, stores a proposed task across a reload, and keeps the notes with a retry message when task extraction fails

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). …（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 When task extraction fails or is slow, the physician sees a visible in-progress state and then a clear message and can retry (or the backup model answers, recorded per 3.9); …（UAT 3.5；UAT OAT-03）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's specs with the extractor mocked: a resident with 'Recheck INR' and 'PT evaluation' (snf-save-extract.spec.ts); a Hospital patient whose extractor returns one task (encounter-workflow.spec.ts); a Hospital patient whose extractTasks call fails once (medication-detection.spec.ts, trackActionRequests failFirst)

When Run the three tests by exact title

Then Nursing Home: '✓ Tasks updated — 1 completed, 2 added'; INR done, PT open, the model's task and the codeword task stored. Hospital: the proposed task shown and stored after a reload. Hospital with a failed extraction: an alert that task extraction failed with 'Tap again to retry', the notes saved and the medication update kept

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Evidence for the app's half of U2/U4/U5 in both contexts and the Hospital message of U14; not evidence that the model matches results to tasks (S04/S05), and nothing here checks the Nursing Home failure path, that tasks are left unchanged by a failure, the retry or the double tap (S26)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
